210756183.Title: Regional Strategy & Transaction Manager - Vice President
210756183.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Join us and make a difference by leading high-impact transactions and collaborating with diverse teams. This role offers the opportunity to influence portfolio decisions, drive innovation, and work with stakeholders across the region. You will be empowered to deliver best practices and strategic leadership. Take your career to the next level with us.

As a Regional Strategy & Transaction Manager – Vice President in our Asia Pacific team, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing real estate strategies that support our business objectives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, manage end-to-end transaction processes, and ensure our portfolio remains competitive and efficient. Whilst providing key support to the region lead, you will be responsible for managing assigned transactions across Asia Pacific, mainly focused on JPMorgan’s India & Philippines office and regional data center portfolio. Together, we will create value for our business and communities by optimizing our real estate footprint and driving key initiatives.

Job responsibilities

  • Prepare real estate strategic plans in partnership with the Regional Strategy & Transaction head
  • Coordinate with internal functional groups including finance, design and construction, real estate consultants, and business teams to ensure comprehensive strategic planning
  • Manage the RFP process and select real estate consultants, brokers, and agents to support strategic and transactional requirements
  • Lead building selection and RFP processes for securing locations, conducting due diligence, and negotiating with developers and landlords
  • Provide program management and analytics, collaborating with the business underwriting team on financial modeling and evaluation of transaction options
  • Negotiate lease and purchase contracts and manage documentation with real estate consultants and legal counsel
  • Oversee lease reporting to meet regional and global requirements, flagging upcoming lease expiries and ensuring timely renewals
  • Support the implementation of key real estate initiatives as a Program Manager
  • Champion real estate occupancy metrics such as cost per square foot and vacancy rates
  • Conduct competitive landscape analysis, including portfolio pricing and market positioning

 

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate or equivalent
  • Minimum of five years’ experience as a real estate transaction manager in a major multinational company or principal real estate consultancy
  • Strong real estate market knowledge in multiple countries across Asia Pacific
  • Excellent planning skills
  • Solid understanding of financials
  • Effective leadership, communication, and collaboration skills

 

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Ten years’ experience as a real estate transaction manager in a major multinational company
  • Extensive real estate market knowledge and experience across Asia Pacific

210795342.Title: Commercial & Investment Bank - Strategy - Executive Director
210795342.ExternalDescriptionStr:
JPMorganChase is a leading global financial services firm with a strong presence across Asia Pacific, serving corporations, governments, institutions and investors across Banking, Markets, Payments, Securities Services, Asset and Wealth Management services.

As an Executive Director in the APAC Firmwide Strategy team, you will support and advise the APAC CEO and APAC business leadership. You will shape the region’s strategic agenda, originate and evaluate growth opportunities, and drive critical initiatives from decision to execution. You will build relationships, drive consensus across diverse groups, and mobilize teams across a complex matrix to deliver measurable outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own CEO-level problem statements: Translate APAC CEO and business leadership priorities into clear workplans, decision points, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Build relationships and trust: Establish a high-confidence advisory cadence with senior leaders across the region and globally; act as a neutral, outcomes-focused partner.
  • Drive decisions and alignment: Lead senior stakeholder engagement across lines of business, functions, and countries; manage trade-offs and drive consensus.
  • Originate growth initiatives: Identify and structure growth opportunities (clients, products, markets, organic/inorganic), build investment cases, and secure senior sponsorship.
  • Lead end-to-end strategy delivery: Run hypothesis-driven work, shape direction, and convert strategy into execution roadmaps with owners, timelines, and KPIs.
  • Create executive narratives: Influence with compelling storylines and deliver materials for CEO/business leadership forums.
  • Build and lead high-performing teams: Set a strong operating cadence, coach junior team members, and deliver as “one team” with partners and stakeholders.
  • Develop strategy capabilities: Raise the bar on structured thinking and communication; strengthen ways of working, including practical AI enablement where it improves productivity and quality.

 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • 10+ years’ experience in top-tier strategy consulting, internal strategy, corporate development, or high-growth/entrepreneurial environments with increasing leadership scope.

210745738.Title: APAC Onboarding Officer
210745738.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Join our dynamic Client Operations team and be at the forefront of innovation in the banking industry. This role offers an exciting opportunity to engage with clients, address inquiries, and optimize service operations, all while contributing to our culture of excellence and efficiency.


As an Associate within the Asset and Wealth Management (AWM) operations team, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our client onboarding experience and providing comprehensive support across various products and platforms. You will address client inquiries, process transactions, and troubleshoot problems, identifying opportunities to refer services based on client needs. Your broad knowledge of client operations, strategic planning, anti-fraud awareness, and automation will be key in optimizing our service center operations. Your ability to influence and manage internal stakeholders will drive improvements and resolve short-term problems within established policies, making a meaningful impact within our department.

Job responsibilities 

  • Support the end-to-end client onboarding process, ensuring a seamless experience across various products and platforms. 
  • Address client inquiries and troubleshoot problems, utilizing your developing skills in strategic planning and anti-fraud awareness. 
  • Process transactions accurately and efficiently, adhering to established policies and procedures. 
  • Identify opportunities to refer services based on client needs, contributing to the continuous improvement of our service center operations. 
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive mutually beneficial outcomes, leveraging your skills in influence and internal stakeholder management. 
  • Conduct client due diligence promptly, ensuring compliance with quality and detail standards as per Policy & Procedures, while analyzing AML risks from a technical perspective and identifying and escalating potential risks and operational issues as necessary.
  • Provide advice and guidance to team members and internal stakeholders within own area of responsibility to create and foster an environment of continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for Bankers, managing expectations and improving the client experience, while driving effective issue resolution within policy boundaries and ensuring cases are completed according to defined service level agreements. 
  • Facilitate all queries for that cases within own area of responsibility, including escalations around PEP, screening, regulatory, compliance, legal and operational risk.
  • Contribute ideas and participate in efforts to drive continuous improvement to enhance service delivery.
     

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 

  • At least 2 years of experience or equivalent expertise in client service and/or operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply strategic planning principles in a client operations context, with a focus on improving service center operations. 
  • Experience in implementing anti-fraud strategies to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions, contributing to the financial and reputational security of the organization. 
  • Proficiency in using automation technologies to optimize service center operations and improve client experience. 
  • Proven skills in managing internal stakeholders, with the ability to establish productive working relationships and drive mutually beneficial outcomes. 
  • Bachelor Degree or equivalent.
  • Strong knowledge of Private Banking industry including a sound understanding of KYC, AML , Regulatory requirements (i.e. HKMA and MAS)

210803273.Title: Private Bank Marketing Content Editor (Traditional Chinese) - Associate
210803273.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Help shape how we communicate with Chinese-speaking clients. Combining Chinese-language editorial expertise with financial knowledge, you will conceptualize, translate and adapt English-language materials into clear, accurate and engaging Traditional Chinese content. You will use firm-approved AI and language tools to improve delivery, while applying editorial judgment and maintaining quality and control standards.

 

As a Private Bank Marketing Content Editor (Traditiional Chinese) Associate in the Asia Marketing team, you will oversee Traditional Chinese content across investments, products and solutions, wealth advisory, philanthropy, alternatives, market-specific campaigns, websites, banker communications, client events and leadership communications. You will review AI-generated drafts, refine Chinese-language messaging and coordinate stakeholder reviews, business approvals and required submissions. As tools and workflows evolve, you will contribute increasingly to Chinese-language editing, content adaptation and broader marketing content development across key channels.

 

Job responsibilities

  • Deliver Chinese-language content across marketing channels, including email, web, social media, digital platforms, events and banker/client communications, while contributing to content strategy that aligns messaging, audience needs and business priorities to deepen client engagement and support business growth.
  • Translate, edit, adapt and transcreate English-language source materials into high-quality Chinese-language private banking and wealth management marketing content, with Traditional Chinese as the primary focus and Simplified Chinese support where required.
  • Improve clarity, structure, tone and audience relevance across digital, campaign, event and client communications while preserving approved meaning, financial accuracy, relevant qualifications and brand tone, and escalating substantive changes for review.
  • Use firm-approved AI and translation tools to produce, review and refine drafts within applicable data-handling requirements, applying human quality controls to AI-generated and vendor-produced translations for accuracy, completeness, terminology, fluency, unsupported additions and market-appropriate language before approval.
  • Partner with content owners, marketing, product and solutions, legal and compliance stakeholders to clarify source materials, resolve financial, linguistic or contextual questions, support applicable marketing and cross-border reviews, and escalate questions to the relevant approvers.
  • Coordinate end-to-end content workflows, including intake, prioritisation, timelines, version control, stakeholder reviews, business and compliance approvals, documentation submissions and timely escalation in accordance with established processes.
  • Maintain Chinese terminology glossaries, editorial style guides and reusable language resources, using validated financial terminology and recurring review findings to improve consistency, turnaround time, AI-assisted workflows, vendor quality and translation efficiency.
  • Review and confirm translation accuracy where required, maintaining quality-control records and distinguishing linguistic review from business or compliance approval.
  • Manage external vendor delivery, including briefing, quality feedback, timelines and payment processing, while identifying opportunities to improve turnaround, reduce rework and optimise external translation spend without compromising quality or control standards.
